title: Log tail
pitch: Watch a bounded log fill with synthetic events, then search the run with the find bar.
makeItYours: Replace the inline messages with your event source.
Keep a bounded buffer when following long runs.
Choose which levels deserve warning or failure colours, and what the reader searches for afterwards.
useCase: Use it when a command needs a bounded live event log that preserves its final state and can be searched afterwards.

states.caption: Ctrl+F and a query: every match is highlighted and counted
